claim: The sample demo never reads or overwrites real session data.
where: landing demo action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser page with a sentinel real-data key; enter /demo/ and assert separate demo: storage

claim: The bundled sample flow sends no data to another origin.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request while playing and reviewing sample data

claim: Each review contains no more than five learner-authored questions.
sandbox: open /demo/ and complete the seeded five-question review

claim: The active session can be exported as JSON.
sandbox: open /demo/ and assert a named JSON download begins

claim: Pressing slash focuses transcript search.
sandbox: open /demo/, press slash, and assert focus on the labelled search field

claim: Selecting a transcript timestamp moves playback to that exact segment time.
sandbox: open /demo/, select the 00:04 timestamp, and assert the audio scrubber moves to four seconds

claim: Import requires consent and offers three local models and six Spanish contexts.
sandbox: open the real import flow and inspect the required consent control and model/context options

claim: The app imports chosen files and never requests microphone or camera capture.
sandbox: instrument getUserMedia, open the import flow, and assert no capture request

claim: The local import flow requires no account or sign-in.
where: landing first-screen facts, app empty state
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the real import flow and assert there are no identity fields or account requests

claim: A €24 one-time license has a hosted checkout and paste-to-restore path.
sandbox: open the license screen and assert the exact price, Sociobot checkout URL, and restore field

claim: The site loads no third-party scripts or analytics endpoints.
sandbox: record landing requests and script sources while mocking the documented GitHub metadata request

claim: Sessions persist in the application's local browser storage.
sandbox: seed one local session, reload the app, and assert it is restored

claim: A user can delete a complete local session.
sandbox: seed one session, confirm deletion, and assert the stored session list is empty

claim: The free tier includes three sessions and five pins per session.
sandbox: seed three sessions and assert a fourth opens the €24 license screen

claim: The landing page selects a platform installer from GitHub release metadata.
sandbox: mock api.github.com release metadata and assert the matching release asset URL

claim: The landing page remains usable when no matching release asset is available.
sandbox: return an empty release asset list and assert a calm release-page fallback with no console error

claim: The shell and PowerShell installers verify SHA-256 before opening or installing a package.
sandbox: local HTTP fixture; run both shipped installers and assert matching bytes install while a mismatched checksum fails and installs nothing

claim: The native app installs a model only after its pinned SHA-256 hash matches and deletes a corrupt download.
sandbox: temporary native model directory; install matching fixture bytes, reject corrupt bytes, and assert the partial file is deleted

claim: After its model download, the native app decodes and transcribes the chosen audio locally.
sandbox: verified public Tiny model plus shipped synthetic Spanish WAV; block HTTP proxies during the native decode and Whisper transcription

claim: The Linux AppImage can initialize and play the bundled sample audio.
where: Linux download action and desktop sample action
sandbox: fresh AppImage under Xvfb/DBus with the audio-smoke entry; require a delayed WebKit marker and no missing autoaudiosink error

claim: Paid limits open only for a token with a valid cached verdict; that verdict is reused for one day.
sandbox: fresh browser contexts; reject a forged token offline, then verify a real fixture token once and prove its cached offline access
